\par\smallskip{\footnotesize\raggedright\textit{Note.} Retention difference: mean over matched controls parseable under both conditions of the per-case retention (share of gold valid-claim signatures that appear anywhere on the supported side; lenient) under C4 minus C2, with a case-level bootstrap 95\% CI (B = 10000). Supported-side items per case: number of scorer supported-side items (the four optimizedCv sections, supportedClaims, and the evidence text and notes of supported or partial requirements), mean over all 144 cases (unparseable = 0). Empty supported side: cases parseable under both conditions whose C4 artifact has no supported-side item. Controls with any repair action: non-empty repair log; supported side changed: at least one supported-side item relabeled, moved out or deleted; retention changed: controls scorable under both conditions whose retention differs. Repair events: entries of the C4 repair logs (in parentheses, cases with at least one such event, risk and control together). Relabel: a supported-side claim moved to unsupportedClaims; delete or replace: deleted items or evidence and replaced text fields (including protected-attribute and decision-language items); move: subjective content moved to interviewSignalRisks. Requirement-status, structural and other events are not listed. qwen3:30b-a3b's retention does not change, yet 26/72 of its controls had supported-side items relabeled or deleted. Most of gpt-oss:20b's drop in supported-side items comes from optimizedCv items written as bare strings without a source ID (1453 in C2), which \texttt{claim\_\allowbreak{}has\_\allowbreak{}source} relabels wholesale; with string lifting switched off its retention difference is $-$0.70 pp (1 of 71 paired controls change; sensitivity table).\par}
